notes.title: Discount and Yuri Bundle Update
notes.content:
Summer is ending, it's time for Spooky Girl Autumn. Black Closet is on sale this week!

Also, we've recently released a new light-yuri game, which has been added to the Yuri Bundle collection:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1085/Hanako_Yuri_Bundle/

Purchase together with Black Closet for added discounts!

notes.title: Feature Update (May 2016)
notes.content:
A new patch has been pushed out with a handful of changes.

The menu should now make it more obvious that "Save and Quit" is an option, if you need to save mid-week.

A bug preventing the scene where [spoiler]Althea[/spoiler] pulls out of the council has been corrected. The scene has also been updated so that you can make her return skill-training points that have been spent on her, and adds a hint that you should be focusing your training on your most loyal minions.

Some minor crash bugs have been fixed.

More detail on the most recent update can be found in this thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/400580/discussions/0/361787186421906510/

Please use that thread to report any problems.

Thanks!

notes.title: Small patch - 1.2.26
notes.content:
The features previously in beta have now gone stable. This includes a few crash fixes and some subtle feedback improvements (for example, hardened criminals returning from suspension will indicate that you have no choice but to expel them, and some minions who do not want to be your Queen will now hint that and give you a chance to change your mind)

If you encounter any problems please report them on the forums:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/400580/discussions/0/483367798506584994/

notes.title: 1.2.16 update in beta
notes.content:
A handful of stability fixes and a change to one case to make it easier to solve are currently available on the beta branch.
 
We're also trying to get CG unlocks to sync properly across the cloud. If you're playing the game in multiple locations, please let us know if the new version is working better for you.

Forum discussion thread for the patch, including full changelog: 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/400580/discussions/0/517142892053921594/

To access the beta:
Right-click on the game in your steam library and select Properties. That should bring up a box with various options tabs, one of which says 'Betas'. On that tab, you'll see a dropdown with a list of options you can choose from - select "beta" and it should patch up to the new test content.

tags.feature: - We're also trying to get CG unlocks to sync properly across the cloud.
